text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: sustained 5xx spike (gateway errors + upstream timeouts) on inference-gateway.prod - route=/v1/generate - current 5xx rate ~13% (baseline 0.2%) - severity: P2

Alex Chen: Paging oncall, seeing a big jump in 5xx and some connection timeouts. Dashboard shows spike at 16:22 UTC. Impacting ~20% of requests to /v1/generate.

Sasha Patel: @ryan are you oncall? can you confirm if this is infra or model-side?

Ryan Kim: I'm oncall, looking. Top-level: LB -> Envoy -> model-pool. Envoy upstream 503/524s in logs. Suspect retry/circuit-breaker misconfiguration causing retry amplification.

Alex Chen: Logs from envoy show many consecutive 502/503 with no upstream healthy host rotation. snippet:
```
[envoy] upstream_5xx count=3240 route=/v1/generate cluster=model-pool region=us-west-2
[envoy] connection_failure: connect_timeout to 10.2.34.11
```

Maria Gomez: Customer-impact: we've got support tickets from 3 customers reporting degraded generation, one large customer saw request latency >30s and failures. Need an ETA for mitigation.

Ryan Kim: Quick hypothesis: circuit_breakers.max_connections or max_requests thresholds are too low and Envoy is tripping, then LB retries reroute/bounce causing thundering. Also saw Envoy retry_policy on route allowing retries on 5xx which amplifies.

Alex Chen: Options: 1) temporarily disable LB-initiated retries for this route 2) relax Envoy circuit breaker thresholds 3) shift traffic away from suspected hosts (drain). Which is least risky?

Sasha Patel: Do we have a safe plan to change retries quickly? We can flip retry config at ingress LB with a controlled rollout.

Ryan Kim: I'm going to: a) reduce route retries to 0, b) bump circuit_breakers.max_connections to 2000 for model-pool cluster, c) mark two hosts for drain and route traffic to reserve pool. Applying now.

infra-bot: Deploy started by ryan (infra-config) - change set: ingress/retry_policy -> retries: 0, cluster/model-pool/circuit_breakers -> max_connections: 2000. Rollout percentage: 10% -> 100% over 2 min.

Alex Chen: Noted. Also putting short-lived override to route weight to send 30% to model-pool-fallback. Command: `curl -XPOST https://infra.api/route-weight -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","weights":{"model-pool":70,"model-pool-fallback":30}}'`

infra-bot: Route weight update applied. model-pool-fallback receiving 30% traffic.

Sasha Patel: After the retry toggle, 5xx dropped from 13% -> 6% in 60s. After increasing circuit_breakers, trending to 2% in 3m. Good sign.

Ryan Kim: Drain of hosts 10.2.34.11 & 10.2.34.12 complete, they were showing high connect_timeout counters. Suspect transient network flaps in that AZ.

SupportBot: Notifying affected customers: ticket #INC-4231 updated, status: investigating, ETA: mitigation in progress.

Maria Gomez: Customer impact update sent to CSMs. Will follow up if >30m.

Alex Chen: Next steps: keep retries disabled for 30m, monitor error budget and latency. Schedule a postmortem if issue not resolved in 2h.

Ryan Kim: I'll open a follow-up runbook item to tighten canary gating for LB retry rollouts; also adding a metric alert for retry-amplification (5xx * retry_count).

Sasha Patel: Thanks team. I'll stay on the thread for the handoff. If errors stay <1% for 30m, we'll revert weights and restore conservative retry policy.

IncidentBot: On-call handoff: Ryan Kim -> Maria Gomez in 35m. Reminder: create post-incident ticket if customer-impact > 15min.

Maria Gomez: Acknowledged, will take primary after handoff and coordinate postmortem and customer comms.

Alex Chen: TL;DR: root cause likely transient host/network flaps + aggressive LB retry + conservative circuit breaker thresholds = exponential 5xx. Mitigation: disabled retries, increased cb thresholds, drained bad hosts, shifted 30% to fallback. Monitoring shows steady recovery.

Ryan Kim: Closing temporary config in 40m if stable. Leaving tasks: revert weight, re-enable retries with stricter conditions (retry on 5xx only for 503, limit retry_count=1), and file infra change for canary gating.

Sasha Patel: :thumbsup: documented in incident channel.
